annotations.title: List Reddit funding instruments (can this account pay?)

description: List the funding instruments (cards, credit lines, insertion orders) on a Reddit ad account and whether each can pay for delivery — Reddit’s own is_servable flag plus its reasons when not (outside its dates, credit line used up, card not approved, not active, test). This is the answer to "why isn’t my Reddit campaign spending?" when everything is ACTIVE, and the source of the fundingInstrumentId create_reddit_ads_campaign accepts. mode: ALL (default), ACTIVE, INACTIVE, UPCOMING or SELECTABLE. Read-only, free.

adAccountId.description: Reddit ad account id (a2_...); omit when only one is shared
